newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Acer Jan-Nov sales down 4.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Acer Jan-Nov sales down 4.1 pct.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc's combined January-November sales fell 4.1 percent to T$53.518 billion from the same period a year ago, a company statement said on Tuesday.
In the month of November, Acer's sales were T$5.563 billion, down 35.3 percent from November 1995.
It did not give profit figures.
Acer, Taiwan's largest computer firm, attributed the declines to slowing personal computer sales in the U.S. market and falling semiconductor prices overseas.
But the statement said Acer still hoped to achieve its 1996 profit target of T$3 billion on sales of T$68.52 billion. ($1 = T$27.5) -- Taipei Newsroom (2-5080815)
